short.text: Bryan Anger has been a viable NFL starting punter for Jacksonville. He was active for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games in 2013, punting {{2013.regular.punts}} times, and he has {{2014.regular.punts}} punts in {{2014.regular.games:words}} games in 2014. His best weapon is a strong leg for distance, with useful hang time and operation, and in camp he put the recorded situational punts to the side the staff called for. Directional punting and control in plus territory are less developed than his leg.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
